job.job_title: Quality Engineer Full Stack (Agentic AI / Python)
job.job_description:
Design and execute test strategies for Python-based Agentic AI applications.
Validate multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and autonomous workflows.
Build automated testing frameworks using Pytest, Unittest, Behave, or Robot Framework.
Develop a mocking and simulation environment for multi-agent interactions.
Create integration tests for agents, retrievers, APIs, and ML components.
Design data-driven test cases for varied AI inputs and outputs.
Job Requirements
Strong QA/Full Stack testing experience with 7+ years of experience.
Experience with Agentic AI/AI-based applications (RAG, LLM workflows).
Hands-on experience with test frameworks like Pytest, Robot Framework, or Behave.
Experience in API testing and integration testing.
Strong analytical and debugging skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
Candidate must be available for a Face-to-Face interview at IBM location if required.
Day 1 reporting from the date of joining is mandatory.
